# netbird_users (Data Source)

List Users matching all the given filters (at least one). Unlike `netbird_user`, matching nothing is not an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All parameters are optional but at least one is required, users matching all
# included criteria are returned
data "netbird_users" "example" {
  role            = "admin"
  status          = "active"
  is_service_user = false
  is_blocked      = false
  # Users having all the auto groups mentioned are included, even if they have more
  auto_groups = ["ch8i4ug6lnn4g9hqv7m0"]
}

data "netbird_users" "service" {
  is_service_user = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_groups` (List of String) Only return users having all these auto group IDs, even if they have more
- `email` (String) Only return the user with this email
- `is_blocked` (Boolean) Only return blocked (`true`) or unblocked (`false`) users
- `is_service_user` (Boolean) Only return service users (`true`) or regular users (`false`)
- `issued` (String) Only return users issued by this source (`api` or `integration`)
- `name` (String) Only return users with this name
- `role` (String) Only return users with this role
- `status` (String) Only return users with this status (`active`, `invited` or `blocked`)

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the matching users
- `users` (Attributes List) Matching users (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `auto_groups` (List of String) Group IDs to auto-assign to peers registered by this user
- `email` (String) User email
- `id` (String) User ID
- `is_blocked` (Boolean) If set to true then user is blocked and can't use the system
- `is_current` (Boolean) Set to true if the caller user is the same as the one returned
- `is_service_user` (Boolean) If set to true then user is a service user
- `issued` (String) User issue method
- `last_login` (String) User last login
- `name` (String) User name
- `role` (String) User's NetBird account role
- `status` (String) User's status
